othercustomfield.description: The exact payload string the Middleware last accepted for this address line. Change detection for an address is a direct comparison of this against the freshly built address payload. It matters more here than anywhere else: the Middleware address endpoint CREATES only, so re-sending an unchanged address does not update it - it adds a duplicate. NEVER written on a failure, or a failed address would compare equal on the next save and never sync again. Written by the SuiteApp only.
